blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) methods such as GRPO rely on successful self-generated trajectories, but finite rollout budgets can produce all-fail groups with no reward-based policy-gradient signal. While additional rollouts improve the chance of success at higher cost, successful trajectories missing from one model’s rollouts may already have been discovered by another. Indeed, we observe that heterogeneous models often succeed on complementary prompts, creating opportunities for mutual learning without a designated stronger teacher. To exploit this complementarity, we propose GRAFT ( G ated R eplacement of A nswer- F ailed groups with peer T rajectories), an off-policy-aware framework that replaces all-fail groups with informative peer groups. GRAFT transfers both successful and unsuccessful peer responses with peer-computed advantages, while controlling cross-model mismatch through sequence-level compatibility weighting and token-level importance ratio clipping. Across three heterogeneous model pairs and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, GRAFT consistently improves both models over GRPO with the same per-model rollout budget, gaining 2.1 points on average and up to 4.5 points in model-level average performance. Stored peer trajectories preserve most of the gains, improving over GRPO by 1.8 points on average without simultaneous co-training.
blocks.zh: GRPO等可验证奖励(RLVR)方法的强化学习依赖于成功的自我生成的轨迹,但有限的推出预算可以产生全失败组,没有基于奖励的政策级信号. 虽然更多的推出增加了以更高成本取得成功的机会,但一个模型推出过程中缺失的成功轨迹可能已经由另一个模型发现。 的确,我们发现,各种模式往往在互补的激励下取得成功,在没有指定更强有力的教师的情况下创造了相互学习的机会。 为了利用这种互补性,我们提议将GRAFT(G ated R eplacement of A nswer-F ailed groups with pare T rajections)作为政策外框架,以提供信息的同龄人小组取代所有失败小组。 GRAFT传送成功和不成功的同行反应,具有同行计算优势,同时通过序列级兼容权重和符号级重要性比剪切控制跨模型不匹配. 在三个不同的模型对和五个数学推理基准中,GRAFT用同样的每个模型推出预算来不断改进两个模型,平均获得2.1分,在模型一级的平均业绩最高达到4.5分。 存储的同行轨迹保留了大部分收益,比GRPO平均提高了1.8分,而没有同时进行共同培训.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a key post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning ability of Large Language Models (LLMs), with substantial gains on many reasoning tasks ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Lambert et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) .
Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) and its variants ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) optimize the policy using relative rewards among sampled responses, raising the likelihood of high-reward trajectories and suppressing low-reward ones.
In this on-policy setting, learning reinforces successful reasoning strategies from self-generated trajectories, without fine-grained supervision ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Wen et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
以可验证的奖励加强学习(RLVR)已成为提高大语言模型推理能力的关键培训后范例,在许多推理任务上取得了实质性成果(Shao等人,2024年;Lambert等人,2025年;Guo等人,2025年)。
集团相对政策优化(GRPO)(Shao等人,2024年)及其变体(Yu等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年b;Zheng等人,2025年b;Kim等人,2026年)利用抽样答复中的相对奖励优化政策,提高高回报轨迹的可能性,抑制低回报轨迹.
在这种政策背景下,学习强化了从自生的轨迹中成功的推理战略,没有精细的监督(Guo等人,2025年;Wen等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
The effectiveness of this learning process depends on whether the model discovers a successful trajectory within its rollout budget ( Liu et al., 2026a ; Yue et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2026 ) .
This limitation arises when every sampled response fails, leaving all group-relative advantages at zero.
Such groups can be dropped, their prompts replaced, or their rewards reshaped to recover a non-zero learning signal ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Le et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ) , while increasing the group size improves the odds of sampling a correct trajectory at higher rollout cost.
These approaches, however, remain dependent on the learner’s own exploration.
blocks.zh:
这一学习过程的有效性取决于该模型是否在其推出预算中发现了成功的轨迹(Liu等人,2026a); Yue等人,2025年;Dong等人,2026年).
当每个抽样答复都失败时,就会出现这种限制,使所有与组有关的优势都变为零。
此类群体可以被丢弃,他们的提示被替换,或者他们的奖励被重塑,以恢复一个非零学习信号(Yu等人,2025年;Le等人,2026年;He等人,2026年),同时增加群体规模提高了以较高推出成本取样正确轨迹的概率.
然而,这些办法仍然取决于学习者自己的探索。

blocks.en:
The growing diversity of open-source LLMs creates an opportunity to move beyond learning solely from self-generated trajectories: a successful response missing from one model’s rollouts may already be present in another’s.
Yet standard single-model RLVR trains each policy in isolation, leaving these successes unused.
We observe this complementarity in independent GRPO runs of SmolLM3-3B-Base ( Bakouch et al., 2025 ) and Qwen3-1.7B-Base ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , two models with distinct pretraining histories ( Figure 1 ).
SmolLM3-3B-Base solves 47.9% of the prompts on which Qwen3-1.7B-Base fails across all eight rollouts, while Qwen3-1.7B-Base solves 18.7% of SmolLM3-3B-Base’s all-fail prompts.
These complementary successes suggest that both models could benefit from exchanging verified solutions, without requiring a designated stronger teacher.
blocks.zh:
开放源代码有限责任公司日益多样化,创造了一种机会,超越仅仅从自我创造的轨迹中学习:一个模型推出时缺少的成功反应可能已经存在于另一个模型。
然而,标准单型RLVR对每项政策进行孤立的训练,使这些成功没有被利用。
在SmolLM3-3B-Base(Bakouch等人,2025年)和Qune3-1.7B-Base(Yang等人,2025年)这两个具有不同预训历史的模型中,我们观察到这种互补性。
SmolLM3-3B-Base解决了Qwen3-1.7B-Base在全部8个推出中失败的47.9%的提示,而Qwen3-1.7B-Base解决了18.7%的SmolLM3-3B-Base全故障提示.
这些相辅相成的成功表明,两种模式都可以从交换经核实的解决办法中受益,而不需要指定的更强有力的教师。

blocks.en:
Turning complementary successes into learning gains requires deciding which prompts warrant peer supervision and how to learn from peer responses.
These choices interact: all-fail prompts lack a reward-based policy-gradient signal, but successful peer responses may still be poorly matched to the receiver. Conversely, transferring peer responses on prompts with an informative self-generated group changes an update that already has an on-policy learning signal.
HACPO ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) accounts for cross-model mismatch but shares peer rollouts beyond receiver-failure prompts, while SGT ( Liu et al., 2026b ) targets receiver failures through a fixed-weight supervised loss without compatibility-based weighting. Applying either update rule to our selected prompts still underperforms GRAFT ( Section 6.3 ). This motivates pairing complementary prompt selection with compatibility-aware learning from full peer groups.
blocks.zh:
将互补的成功转化为学习成果需要决定哪些因素需要同行监督,以及如何从同行反应中学习。
这些选择相互影响:全失败的提示缺乏基于奖励的政策级信号,但成功的同行反应仍然可能与接收者不匹配. 相反,通过信息丰富的自我生成的小组来传送对提示的同行反应,改变了已经具有政策学习信号的更新。
HACPO(Zhang等人,2026年)对跨型号不匹配进行了说明,但分享了超出接收器故障提示的对等推展,而SGT(Liu等人,2026b)则通过不兼容性加权的固定重量监督损失来瞄准接收器故障. 将更新规则应用到我们选定的提示中仍然表现不佳的GRAFT(第6.3节). 这促使将互补的即时选择与从完全对等群体学习的兼容性认识结合起来。

blocks.en:
We propose GRAFT ( G ated R eplacement of A nswer- F ailed groups with peer T rajectories), an off-policy-aware framework for cross-model trajectory sharing in RLVR that addresses both decisions.
For which , GRAFT selects prompts on which the receiver fails entirely and the peer produces both successful and unsuccessful responses, while balancing exchange volume across directions.
For how , it replaces the selected receiver groups with the corresponding peer groups and retains their source-computed advantages, preserving within-peer reward contrast without pooling rewards across models.
It controls peer influence through bounded sequence-level compatibility gating and token-level importance ratio clipping, and keeps the receiver’s own data primary by processing peer-containing minibatches after its on-policy minibatches.
blocks.zh:
我们提议将GRAFT(G ated R eplacement of A nswer-F iled groups with pare T rajections)作为RLVR跨模型轨迹共享的不具有政策意识的框架,其中涉及两项决定。
GRAFT为此选择了接收器完全失效的提示,对等端生成成功和不成功的答复,同时平衡方向的交换量.
关于如何,它将选定的接收组替换为相应的对等组,并保留其源代码优势,保持对等组内部的奖励对比,而不将奖励汇集到不同的模型中。
它通过限定序列的兼容性标点和符号级的重要性比剪接来控制同伴的影响,并通过处理其政策小管后含有同伴的小管来保持接收者自己的数据主线。

blocks.en:
Across three heterogeneous pairs of open-source base models and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, GRAFT improves both models in every pair over GRPO ( n = 8 n{=}8 ), by 2.1 points on average and up to 4.5 points in model-level average score.
In two of the three pairs, both models match or exceed GRPO trained with four times the rollout budget ( n = 32 n{=}32 ).
GRAFT also outperforms HACPO and SGT by 4.0 and 1.5 points on average, respectively.
The gains largely persist when reusing peer trajectories from completed independent GRPO runs ( + 1.8 +1.8 points on average), without simultaneous co-training or additional peer rollouts.
blocks.zh:
GRAFT通过三种不同的开源基模型和五个数学推理基准,在GRPO(n = 8 n{=}8)之上每对模型改进了两种模型,平均分数为2.1分,在模型级平均分数中最高可达4.5分.
在三对中的两对中,两种型号都以4倍于推出预算(n=32n{=}32)的GRPO训练匹配或超过.
GRAFT的成绩也分别比HACPO和SGT平均高出4.0分和1.5分.
如果重复使用已完成的独立GRPO运行的同行轨道(平均+1.8+1.8分),而不同时进行联合培训或增加同行推广,则收益在很大程度上持续下去。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
GRPO and related RLVR methods learn only from reward variation within self-generated rollout groups ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) .
Dynamic sampling discards zero-variance groups and resamples ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , while larger groups improve success coverage; both cost extra rollouts without guaranteeing success.
Entropy-guided advantage shaping recovers a signal without additional rollouts ( Le et al., 2026 ) , but on an all-incorrect group it can only suppress the sampled failures, not supply a correct response.
Even at scale, RLVR improves sampling efficiency without expanding the base model’s solvable prompt set ( Yue et al., 2025 ) , and declining entropy further limits exploration ( Cui et al., 2025 ) .
Hints, partial solutions, and expert guidance ease exploration but require an external solution source or a stronger model ( Li et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) .
We instead use trajectories from heterogeneous peers when the learner’s own rollouts all fail.

blocks.en:
External demonstrations, teacher solutions, and historical trajectories augment RLVR rollouts but introduce policy mismatch ( Yan et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2026 ; Mao et al., 2026 ) .
Prior work addresses rollout–training mismatch through importance weighting and truncation ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Ling Team et al., 2025 ) , and studies sequence-level optimization and off-policy correction ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) .
We consider distinct peer models with potentially different tokenizers.
GRAFT separates within-receiver policy change from cross-model mismatch through token-level importance ratio clipping and sequence-level compatibility filtering with bounded weighting.
The compatibility score is an empirical proxy from average token log-likelihoods, not an exact cross-tokenizer importance ratio.
blocks.zh:
外部示范、教师解决方案和历史轨迹增加了RLVR的推出,但引入了政策不匹配(Yan等人,2025年;Dong等人,2026年;Mao等人,2026年)。
先前的工作涉及通过重要性加权和调试进行的培训不匹配(姚等人,2025年;Ling Team等人,2025年),以及研究序列级优化和政策外校正(郑等人,2025年;陈等人,2025年)。
我们认为,不同的同侪模式具有潜在的不同标志。
GRAFT通过符号级重要性比剪切和序列级兼容性过滤与受限加权将接收方内部的政策变化与跨模型不匹配区分开来.
相容性分数是平均符号对数的实证代词,而不是精确的交叉切换器重要性比.

blocks.en:
Recent work enables multiple models to learn from one another during RL.
HACPO ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) exchanges peer rollouts with off-policy correction, while Mutual RL ( Liu et al., 2026b ) introduces SGT to transfer verified peer successes on prompts where the receiver fails.
F-TIS ( Blagoev et al., 2026 ) studies collaborative GRPO among models from the same family with a shared vocabulary, using truncated importance sampling and off-policy filtering.
Unlike teacher-guided distillation ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) , these approaches motivate learning across peer models without relying exclusively on a designated stronger teacher.
We build on this direction by jointly addressing where peer trajectories provide missing supervision and how their influence should be controlled under cross-model mismatch.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作使多个模型在RL期间互相学习.
HACPO(Zhang等人,2026年)用非政策更正交换同行推广,而Common RL(Liu等人,2026年b月)则引入SGT,在接收器故障时将经核实的同行成功率转移.
F-TIS(Blagoev等人,2026年)研究来自同一家庭的模型之间具有共同词汇的协同GRPO,使用简略重要性抽样和不政策过滤.
与教师指导的蒸馏不同(Agarwal等人,2024年),这些方法激励了同行模型之间的学习,而不完全依赖指定的更强大的教师。
我们以这一方向为基础,共同探讨同行轨道在哪些方面提供缺失监督以及如何在跨模式不匹配的情况下控制其影响。

Cross-model RLVR allows heterogeneous models to learn from trajectories generated by their peers.
HACPO ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) broadly reuses peer rollouts during policy optimization, using capability-aware advantage estimation, sequence-level importance sampling, and clipping to account for cross-model mismatch.
Its sharing is not restricted to prompts where the receiver’s rollout group fails.
SGT ( Liu et al., 2026b ) instead transfers a verified peer success only when the receiver’s entire rollout group fails and a peer succeeds, and learns from it through an auxiliary negative log-likelihood objective alongside on-policy GRPO.
These approaches raise two complementary design questions: which peer trajectories should supplement the receiver’s own rollouts, and how the receiver should optimize on them under cross-model policy mismatch.

blocks.en: 4 GRAFT: Gated Replacement of Answer-Failed Groups with Peer Trajectories
blocks.zh: 4 GRAFT: 以同行轨道取代答题小组

blocks.en:
GRAFT addresses the two design questions introduced in Section 3 : which peer trajectories to transfer, and how the receiver should learn from them under cross-model mismatch ( Figure 2 ).
GRAFT identifies complementary peer groups, replaces receiver groups that provide no successful trajectory, and balances transfer across the two directions ( Section 4.1 ).
The receiver then learns from the transferred trajectories using source-computed advantages, sequence-level compatibility weighting, token-level importance ratio clipping, and peer-last updates ( Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh:
GRAFT涉及第3节中提出的两个设计问题:转移的对等轨迹是什么,以及接收者如何在跨模型不匹配的情况下从中学习(图2)。
GRAFT确定互补的同行小组,取代没有成功轨迹的接收组,并平衡跨越两个方向的转移(第4.1节)。
接收器然后利用源计算优势、序列级兼容权重、符号级重要性比剪接和对等更新,从转移的轨迹中学习(第4.2节)。

blocks.en: We next examine three questions about the gains of GRAFT: whether they come at a better compute trade-off than simply increasing the rollout budget ( Section 6.1 ), whether they strictly require synchronous co-training or persist with stored peer trajectories ( Section 6.2 ), and which components drive them, including whether the which and how decisions must be addressed together ( Section 6.3 ).

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We have introduced GRAFT , an off-policy-aware framework for cross-model trajectory exchange in RLVR. GRAFT exploits complementary successes across heterogeneous models by replacing all-fail rollout groups with informative peer groups, while controlling cross-model mismatch through compatibility-aware and clipped updates. Across three heterogeneous model pairs, GRAFT consistently improves both models over standard GRPO with the same rollout budget and can match or exceed GRPO with substantially more rollouts. Moreover, most of the gains persist when using stored peer trajectories, showing that the benefit of cross-model exploration does not require synchronous co-training.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了GRAFT,这是一个在RLVR进行跨模型轨迹交流的不知情框架。 GRAFT利用各种模型的互补成功,将全失败推出组替换为信息化同行组,同时通过兼容意识和剪切更新控制跨模型不匹配. 在三种不同的模式对中,GRAFT以同样的推出预算,不断改进两种模式,而不是标准的GRPO,并且能够与GRPO相匹配或超过GRPO,推出量大得多。 此外,大多数收益在使用存储的对等轨迹时持续存在,表明跨模型探索的好处不需要同步的共同训练.

blocks.en: GRAFT’s gain depends on how complementary the two models are and is smallest on Pair 3. Across tokenizers, the compatibility score is a proxy, not a density ratio. We also study only two-model pairs, only on math, and only with base models of at most 3B parameters. We leave exchange among more than two peers, and in domains without verifiable rewards, to future work.
blocks.zh: GRAFT的增益取决于两种模式的互补性和最小程度对Pair 3. 在整个标注器中,兼容性分数是一个代理,而不是密度比. 我们还只研究双模型对,只研究数学,并且只研究最多3B参数的基础模型. 我们让两个以上同行之间以及在没有可核查报酬的领域进行交流,以待今后的工作。

blocks.en: We train on the 7,500 problems in the MATH training split, using all difficulty levels. Each problem is formatted as a single user message with the suffix “Let’s think step by step and output the final answer within \boxed {} .” The reward is binary: math_verify checks the final boxed answer against the reference answer, with verification timeouts assigned zero reward. We use no additional format or length reward, and score responses that reach the generation limit as generated.
